messages.subject: Error with AvgPIC data frame
parts:
Hi there,

I'm re-running some code I was working on last month and am now getting an error I didn't get before. After trying to drop one of my populations with gl.drop.pop for further analysis I am getting the message:

Error in `$<-.data.frame`(`*tmp*`, "AvgPIC", value = c(NA, NA, NA, NA,  :
  replacement has 4621 rows, data has 1

I have tried gl.compliance.check and am getting the same error and I can't seem to access the function utils.recalc.avgpic to try and repopulate the metric.

If you have any tips to resolve this that would be amazing as it seems to be a new issue. I am using dartR 2.0.4

Cheers,
Jack
